newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures weaken on auction results.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures weaken on auction results.

text.p: May 7 - U.S. debt futures continued to weaken on the results of the 10-year note auction. The average yield was at 6.74 pct, with the bid-to-cover at 1.86 and non-comp bids at $383 million. June T-bonds fell to 109-09/32, with support seen at 109-06/32. Sept Euros edged slightly below support at 93.83. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
